answer.summary: All 26 AttackPathHttpIsolationTest tests error on setup: INSERT INTO roles is refused by the PL/pgSQL require_tenant_write guard with 'outside the scope of the transaction'. The error is deterministic and identical across tests, and the PR adds the V6 roles-guard migration plus TenantScopedTransaction and RoleRepository changes, so the change most likely caused it. Retry is unlikely to help. Log is from one shard only.
